scope: The loop monoid has infinitely many free generators; its inclusion does not recover the rank-two graph fundamental group.

injective_monoid_noninjective_group_exam.general_injectivity_proof: Every image word has a unique parsing into consecutive length-two blocks.

positive_conjugation_obstruction.general_proof: For c=(ab)a(ab)^-1, positive words have |c|=|a|. In (ab)a=c(ab), initial prefixes give c=a, hence ba=ab. The finite enumeration is not used as the proof.
